$comment: Cluster:MAST. Source: docs/clusters/README.Clusters.md. setIndication and setLit are operational, so they carry no gate. SignalIndication lists the nine words in the order the docs list them; that order is NOT a permissiveness ranking. mast.rulebook is a string in the docs; here it is a closed enum of the rulebooks that have a table under schema/rulebooks/, so a mast can never be set to a rulebook it cannot display. mast.heads stops at 3, the most heads every rulebook has rows for (the generator requires a STOP row for each allowed count). mast.flash_hz stops at 10 Hz (the docs give no bound; a railroad flash is about 1 Hz) so the half period is never below 50 ms.
